{{Short description|none}} {{For|related races|2026 United States Senate elections}} {{Distinguish|2026 Delaware Senate election}} {{Use American English|date=January 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=November 2025}} {{Infobox election | election_name = 2026 United States Senate election in Delaware | country = Delaware | type = presidential | ongoing = yes | previous_election = 2020 United States Senate election in Delaware | previous_year = 2020 | election_date = November 3, 2026 | next_election = 2032 United States Senate election in Delaware | next_year = 2032 | turnout = | image1 = Chris Coons 2024.jpg | nominee1 = [[Chris Coons]] | party1 = Democratic Party (United States) | image2 = 3x4.svg | nominee2 = [[Michael Katz (politician)|Michael Katz]] | party2 = Republican Party (United States) | map_image = | map_caption = | title = U.S. senator | before_election = [[Chris Coons]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = | after_party = }} The '''2026 United States Senate election in Delaware''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Delaware]]. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent [[Chris Coons]] is seeking a third full term. He is being challenged by [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] former state senator [[Michael Katz (politician)|Michael Katz]]. [[Primary elections]] took place on September 15.{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025|title=2026 State Primary Election Dates|url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250507210524/https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|archive-date=May 7, 2025|url-status=live|website=[[National Conference of State Legislatures]]|access-date=August 5, 2025}} Coons won the Democratic nomination with 78% of the vote against minimal opposition. Katz, a former Democratic state senator, won the Republican nomination with 77.3% of the vote against [[U.S. Army War College]] instructor John Shulli. Republicans have not won a Senate election in Delaware since [[1994 United States Senate election in Delaware|1994]]. == Democratic primary == === Candidates === ==== Nominee ==== *[[Chris Coons]],
